rules: Each colony binds exactly one base/weight model at a time.
The colony model is selected from a bank of at most six approved open-weight model candidates.
The six are alternatives for colony assignment, never six simultaneous models inside one colony.
Different colonies may select different candidates; multiple colonies may share the same G0 only with separate colony lineage, memory, adapters and generations.
Every colony remains permanently linked to its seed farm(s); a broken seed-farm link forces HOLD.
Binding requires real availability, immutable revision, license check and baseline evidence.
Training creates colony-specific G1/G2/... artifacts; G0 remains immutable.
Promotion requires cold benchmark, audit, red-team, ablation, transfer and rollback target.
Large/private weights and adapters live on private Hugging Face storage; GitHub stores control-plane metadata/digests only.
